senses.gloss:
Pluṣ is the name of some noxious insect in the Rigveda.^1
It is also included in the list of victims at the Aśvamedha
[]
(‘horse sacrifice’) in the Yajurveda Saṃhitās,^2 and is mentioned
in the Bṛhadāraṇyaka Upaniṣad.^3
Possibly a species of ant
may be meant.
1) i. 191, 1.
2) Maitrāyaṇī Saṃhitā, iii. 14, 8;
Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā, xxiv. 20.
3) i. 3, 24.
Cf. Zimmer, Altindisches Leben, 98.
